design_detail: AVS "Restituzione fiscale": annual progressive wealth tax on net wealth above EUR 5.4m (est. EUR 15.9bn/year) plus 26% exit tax

quote_en: Nicola Fratoianni and Angelo Bonelli call the proposal "fiscal restitution" and ask allies Elly Schlein and Giuseppe Conte to support it.
source_title: Meno tasse al 98% degli italiani e patrimoniale ai super ricchi. La proposta di AVS che sfida Conte e Schlein: "Coraggio"
grading_note: Grade A: co-presented the AVS annual progressive wealth tax package above EUR 5.4m.

design_detail: Budget law amendment for a single ordinary progressive wealth tax on net fortunes above EUR 5.4m
quote_original: un’imposta ordinaria unica e progressiva sui grandi patrimoni sopra i 5,4 milioni di euro, da sola, coprirebbe un fondo per finanziare politiche per la salute
quote_en: a single ordinary progressive tax on large fortunes above 5.4 million euros would by itself cover a fund to finance health policies.
source_title: Bilancio, Grimaldi (AVS): Su patrimoniale non molleremo mai
grading_note: Grade A: sponsored AVS budget amendments for an annual progressive net wealth tax above EUR 5.4m.

design_detail: Senate budget amendment: 1.3% single ordinary annual wealth tax on net wealth above EUR 2m (real estate and financial assets net of liabilities)
quote_original: La proposta del senatore Tino Magni punta a introdurre un'”imposta ordinaria unica” con aliquota unica dell’1,3% sulla ricchezza netta superiore a 2 milioni di euro
quote_en: Senator Tino Magni's proposal aims to introduce a "single ordinary tax" with a flat rate of 1.3% on net wealth exceeding 2 million euros.
source_title: Nella battaglia sulla manovra spunta l’emendamento Avs per tassare i patrimoni oltre 2 milioni di euro
grading_note: Grade A: tabled the November 2025 Senate budget amendment for a 1.3% annual tax on net wealth above EUR 2m.

design_detail: 2020 budget amendment: progressive wealth tax from 0.2% (EUR 500k–1m) to 2% (> EUR 50m) and 3% (> EUR 1bn in 2021)
quote_original: Tassare i grandi patrimoni, per alleggerire il carico fiscale sul ceto medio, per aiutare chi è più in difficoltà
quote_en: Taxing large fortunes, to lighten the tax burden on the middle class, to help those in greatest difficulty.
source_title: Patrimoniale — Matteo Orfini
grading_note: Grade A: co-first signatory of the 2020 budget amendment for a progressive net wealth tax.

design_detail: 2020 budget amendment: progressive wealth tax from 0.2% (EUR 500k–1m) to 2% (> EUR 50m) and 3% (> EUR 1bn in 2021)
quote_original: che è stato sottoscritto nelle ultime ore anche dalla deputata dem Enza Bruno Bossio e dal collega M5s Andrea Colletti
quote_en: which was also signed in recent hours by Democratic MP Enza Bruno Bossio and M5S colleague Andrea Colletti.
source_title: Patrimoniale, riammesso l’emendamento. Fratoianni: “Risparmio per ceto medio”. Orfini: “È nel Dna del Pd”
grading_note: Grade A: co-signed the 2020 Orfini-Fratoianni budget amendment for a progressive wealth tax.

design_detail: National "Millionaire tax" modelled on Oxfam proposal: net wealth above EUR 5m (richest 0.1%, ~50,000 people, est. EUR 15bn/year)
quote_original: Sui patrimoni oltre i cinque milioni di euro, si stima che siano 50mila persone, lo 0,1 per cento della popolazione. Si ricaverebbero 15 miliardi
quote_en: On fortunes over five million euros, estimated at 50,000 people, 0.1 percent of the population. It would raise 15 billion.
source_title: Tassa sui grandi patrimoni, Conte ribadisce il no. Appendino a favore: “Riguarderebbe una ristrettissima élite di super Paperoni”
grading_note: Grade A: interview explicitly advocating a national wealth tax on net wealth above EUR 5m raising EUR 15bn/year.

design_detail: Coordinated European or international minimum wealth tax on the super-rich (G20 / Lula / Zucman 2% billionaire tax model)
quote_original: penso che faccia bene Lula a chiedere al G20 una tassa internazionale sui super ricchi
quote_en: I think Lula is right to ask the G20 for an international tax on the super-rich.
source_title: Schlein a SkyTg24: “Tassa internazionale sui super ricchi? Questa discussione si può fare. Lula ha fatto bene a chiederla al G20”
grading_note: Grade B: endorsed Lula's G20 proposal for an international/European wealth tax on the super-rich.

design_detail: Popular initiative bill 1% Equo: 1%–3.5% progressive annual wealth tax on net wealth above EUR 2m (excluding primary home)
quote_original: primi firmatari Maurizio Acerbo, Pier Giorgio Ardeni, Anna Bruna Camposampiero, Elena Coccia, Francesca Fornario, Alfonso Gianni, Matteo Prencipe

grading_note: Grade A: first signatory of the 7 May 2026 1% Equo popular initiative wealth tax bill.

design_detail: Unified political proposal for a progressive wealth tax on large fortunes (with clear thresholds, rates and expected revenue) alongside inheritance tax reform
quote_original: Tassare i grandi patrimoni non è uno slogan: serve una proposta chiara e condivisa per ridurre le disuguaglianze e ricostruire il patto sociale
quote_en: Taxing large fortunes is not a slogan: a clear and shared proposal is needed to reduce inequalities and rebuild the social contract.
source_title: Tassare i grandi patrimoni: una proposta politica necessaria
grading_note: Grade B: op-ed arguing for a shared political proposal to introduce a progressive wealth tax on large fortunes.

design_detail: Provincial/Regional Council Voto "Tax the Rich" calling on the Italian Government to push for an EU/national wealth tax on large fortunes (#TaxTheRich / > EUR 5.4m agenda)
quote_original: Al fine di chiedere all'Europa di introdurre un'imposta sui grandi patrimoni per finanziare scuola, sanità, misure di contrasto alla povertà
quote_en: In order to ask Europe to introduce a tax on large fortunes to finance schools, healthcare, and anti-poverty measures.
source_title: Voto n. 39/25 — TAX THE RICH (Consiglio della Provincia autonoma di Bolzano)
publisher: Consiglio della Provincia autonoma di Bolzano
grading_note: Grade A: co-sponsored formal council motion Voto n. 39/25 (and Regional Council Voto n. 18) calling for a tax on large fortunes.

design_detail: 1.5% annual solidarity contribution on net wealth above EUR 2m (excluding primary home, richest 500,000 taxpayers, est. EUR 26bn/year)
quote_original: ci sia un contributo di solidarietà dell’1,5% da parte di questi 500 mila contribuenti più ricchi. Questo permetterebbe di incassare circa 26 miliardi di euro
quote_en: that there be a 1.5% solidarity contribution from these 500,000 richest taxpayers. This would raise around 26 billion euros.
source_title: Maurizio Landini: “Un contributo di solidarietà per ridurre le diseguaglianze e finanziare sanità e scuola”
grading_note: Grade A: CGIL General Secretary presenting the union's 1.5% annual net wealth tax proposal above EUR 2m.

design_detail: Progressive wealth tax on the richest 0.1% of Italians (net wealth of at least EUR 5.4m, ~50,000 individuals, three brackets raising EUR 13–15bn/year)
quote_original: verrebbe applicata nel contesto italiano solo allo 0,1% dei nostri connazionali più ricchi. Stiamo parlando di circa 50.000 individui che hanno un patrimonio individuale netto
quote_en: would be applied in the Italian context only to the richest 0.1% of our fellow citizens. We are talking about roughly 50,000 individuals.
source_title: Una tassa per i super ricchi: mettici la firma!
grading_note: Grade A: detailed interview explaining Oxfam Italia's progressive wealth tax proposal on net wealth above EUR 5.4m.

design_detail: Progressive wealth tax (tassa patrimoniale progressiva) including non-labour income to finance a 30% cut in the tax wedge on labour
quote_original: Come finanziarlo? Ma che diamine, con una bella tassa patrimoniale progressiva che includa anche tutti i redditi non da lavoro.
quote_en: How to finance it? With a progressive wealth tax that also includes all non-labour income.
source_title: Carlo De Benedetti cambia l’agenda di Renzi, dalla nazionalizzazione delle banche alla patrimoniale progressiva
grading_note: Grade B: reported Corriere della Sera interview calling for a progressive wealth tax to fund a 30% reduction in labour taxes.

design_detail: Wealth tax on high earners and large fortunes following the 2020 Orfini-Fratoianni proposal
quote_original: Flavio Insinna: “Io privilegiato, pagherei la patrimoniale. Molto dispiaciuto che abbiamo detto “no”: facciamolo presto”
quote_en: Flavio Insinna: "I am privileged, I would pay the wealth tax. Very sorry that we said 'no': let's do it soon."
source_title: Patrimoniale — Matteo Orfini
grading_note: Grade B: public statement supporting a wealth tax and offering to pay it as a privileged citizen.

design_detail: Manifesto Tax the Rich per l'Italia: progressive wealth tax on net wealth above EUR 5.4m (rates 1.7%–3.5%, est. EUR 15.7bn/year)
quote_original: L'idea di un'imposta sui grandi patrimoni non è una reliquia ideologica o la boutade di una sinistra disancorata dalla realtà.
quote_en: The idea of a tax on large fortunes is not an ideological relic or the whim of a left detached from reality.
source_title: Patrimoniale, dietro la polemica politica la proposta degli economisti che chiedono di tassare i ricchi per rendere equo il sistema fiscale
grading_note: Grade B: commentary defending the 134 economists' progressive wealth tax proposal above EUR 5.4m.

design_detail: 2–3% national Zucman-style wealth tax on net wealth above EUR 100m (~2,500–3,000 taxpayers, est. EUR 8bn/year)
quote_original: È un’imposta sulla ricchezza, ma la soglia di 100 milioni la colloca al vertice della distribuzione. La gente comune non verrebbe neanche sfiorata
quote_en: It is a wealth tax, but the 100 million threshold places it at the top of the distribution. Ordinary people would not even be touched.
source_title: Una proposta (in fieri) degli economisti Felice e Visco. Un fisco più progressivo che parta dai super-ricchi
grading_note: Grade B: op-ed arguing that the 2–3% wealth tax above EUR 100m is "the right path" ("A mio avviso è una strada giusta").
